title: Offline media after moving files
causes: Drive letter or folder moved
tests: Open Link Media; verify actual source path and relink one root item
confirm: Inspect first/middle/last frame; confirm correct camera take
prevention: Preserve stable folders; archive together
side_effects: Relinking an identically named wrong take can silently corrupt edit

title: Playback stutters but export is fine
causes: Long-GOP decode, disk bandwidth or effects
tests: Drop preview resolution; disable effects temporarily; compare proxies; check disk and CPU/GPU
confirm: Observe dropped frames and replay identical range
prevention: Use intraframe proxies, SSD and stable drivers
side_effects: Reduced preview quality does not change source quality

title: Green frames / 10-bit 4:2:2 artifacts
causes: Unsupported or faulty decoding path; known Windows case fixed in 26.5.2
tests: Verify exact installed patch; test GPU decoding, alternate encoder and intermediate on a copy
confirm: Reimport transcode and compare frame content
prevention: Keep driver/app matched and test new camera codec
side_effects: Software path can be slower; do not delete original

title: Export fails at the same frame
causes: Effect, corrupt frame, memory or codec
tests: Export a short range around failure; disable effects one at a time; test software encoding
confirm: Log which control changes the failure
prevention: Preflight heavy compositions and source media
side_effects: A transcode can change metadata; preserve masters

title: Exports washed out or darker
causes: Wrong input/sequence/output transform or player color path
tests: Check input color space, sequence working space and export tags; reimport and compare scopes
confirm: Compare in color-managed viewer under fixed conditions
prevention: Keep color management notes for all sources
side_effects: Do not use arbitrary gamma LUT to hide a metadata error

title: Audio peaks red / sounds distorted
causes: Gain staging clips before bus or export
tests: Solo tracks; inspect clip gain, effects and mixer; reduce upstream level
confirm: Re-export, inspect meter peaks and listen on headphones
prevention: Leave headroom; meter after processing
side_effects: Lowering master does not undo already clipped source

title: Only left speaker contains dialogue
causes: Mono/stereo channel mismatch
tests: Inspect source channel map and track layout; remap source before finishing
confirm: Test mono fold-down plus stereo headphones
prevention: Track camera mic channel convention
side_effects: Duplicating distorted channel does not improve quality

title: No audio playback
causes: Muted track, Global Mute, output device or codec issue
tests: Check meters and Global Mute; select correct Windows output; test simple WAV
confirm: Meter movement distinguishes source from device failure
prevention: Document Windows audio device sample rate
side_effects: Changing OS sample rate mid-session can disrupt devices

title: Missing fonts or different-looking titles
causes: Unavailable font on destination machine
tests: Record font family; replace with licensed installed font; inspect MOGRT dependencies
confirm: Compare raster screenshots between machines
prevention: Use bundled/common legally shareable styles
side_effects: Do not distribute restricted commercial fonts

title: Timeline edit causes sync drift
causes: Track locks, Sync Lock state or unlinked media
tests: Undo; inspect target/patch, Track Lock and Sync Lock; ripple a test range
confirm: Compare clap or lip sync pre/post cut
prevention: Document track routing before picture lock
side_effects: Force-overwriting locked tracks may leave gaps

title: Multicam angles drift
causes: Variable frame rate, bad sync or clock discrepancies
tests: Verify matching moment at beginning/middle/end; transcode VFR if needed; resync
confirm: Check common waveform clap and later time marker
prevention: Record reference audio/timecode or clap
side_effects: Waveform alignment at one instant may not prevent drift

title: Generative feature disabled
causes: No connection, credits, unsupported media or account
tests: Check supported release, service status, prompt eligibility, credit terms
confirm: Verify whether UI becomes available after legitimate fix
prevention: Plan manual alternate in advance
side_effects: Do not submit sensitive content without authorization

title: Premiere hangs at splash screen
causes: Driver, plugin, preferences or permission failure
tests: Inspect Adobe diagnostics and recent changes; isolate plug-ins and reset prefs only after backup
confirm: Attempt clean launch in controlled environment
prevention: Update compatible graphics drivers and backup settings
side_effects: Resetting prefs may erase custom shortcuts/layouts

title: Scratch disk is full
causes: Preview/cache/render storage exceeds free space
tests: Identify locations; clear regenerable cache using Adobe UI; move preview destination
confirm: Reopen and replay; verify output disk free space
prevention: Separate cache and source drives where practical
side_effects: Cache removal forces reconforming and regeneration

title: Captions missing from exported video
causes: Wrong export caption mode or disabled caption track
tests: Inspect captions export choice: sidecar vs burn-in vs embedding supported by target
confirm: Play encoded file and inspect sidecar in player
prevention: Make a named caption deliverables checklist
side_effects: SRT sidecar does not carry complete visual styling

title: Projects open but Dynamic Link composition is offline
causes: After Effects version or composition path unavailable
tests: Verify linked app version and file dependencies; reconnect or render intermediate
confirm: Preview linked range and export short sample
prevention: Archive rendered interchange as fallback
side_effects: Rendered workaround loses some editability

title: GPU acceleration option is missing in VM
causes: Virtual adapter lacks passthrough/driver feature
tests: Inspect Device Manager, renderer menu and encode availability; benchmark proxy workflow
confirm: Compare CPU/GPU decode and export timing
prevention: Use supported passthrough only if infrastructure permits
side_effects: Adding VM video memory alone does not create NVENC

title: H.264 looks blocky in motion
causes: Insufficient bitrate, wrong scaling or poor source
tests: Export same span at higher rate or higher quality preset; compare at 100% scale
confirm: Compare frame details and file size
prevention: Use appropriate bitrate/resolution per receiver
side_effects: Bitrate cannot restore information lost in source

title: Mixed footage changes speed unexpectedly
causes: Interpret Footage vs sequence frame rate confusion
tests: Check source fps, speed percentage, interpretation and sequence timebase
confirm: Count reference action frames over actual duration
prevention: Keep an ingest metadata sheet
side_effects: Interpretation can change time rather than just duplicate frames

title: Old Essential Graphics tutorial menus do not exist
causes: UI reorganized to Properties panel
tests: Open Window > Properties and select text graphic; use current Text/Graphics tools
confirm: Confirm selected graphic shows editing controls
prevention: Prefer current Adobe 26.x documentation
side_effects: Historical effects and panels may be removed

title: Source appears stretched or squeezed
causes: Incorrect source pixel aspect ratio, sequence frame shape or scale settings
tests: Inspect the clip properties and sequence dimensions; compare with a known-correct image; reset one transform on a duplicate sequence
confirm: Circles remain round and edge crop is intentional
prevention: Record aspect ratio and pixel interpretation at ingest
side_effects: Changing sequence settings can alter existing graphics

title: Captions drift after ripple changes
causes: Captions were created before a major structural re-edit or not included in the operation
tests: Duplicate sequence; compare captions against speech at start, middle and end; regenerate or retime the affected caption range
confirm: Words appear during the corresponding spoken phrase in exported playback
prevention: Lock picture and dialogue timing before final caption QC
side_effects: Caption track fixes do not correct bad source transcripts

title: Proxy toggle changes framing
causes: Proxy has mismatched frame size, pixel ratio, rotation metadata or time alignment
tests: Compare proxy/original at a recognizable frame, inspect both properties and recreate a matching proxy if needed
confirm: Toggle between attached original and proxy without composition jump
prevention: Make proxies using consistent ingest and frame alignment
side_effects: Replacing proxies can invalidate previous QC notes

title: Transition unexpectedly short or absent
causes: Insufficient outgoing or incoming source handles, clip boundary or incompatible edit
tests: Trim away from clip boundary on a disposable copy; inspect source In/Out and transition alignment
confirm: A controlled transition has the requested duration and no repeated endpoint freeze
prevention: Reserve handles while shooting and selecting shots
side_effects: Creating handles can consume usable frames or change cut point

title: Nested timeline has unexpected audio
causes: Duplicate audio from parent/nest or wrong audio channel mapping
tests: Solo parent and nested tracks separately; inspect source sequence and channel type
confirm: Only intended bus/track reaches the master output
prevention: Name audio buses and define routing before nesting
side_effects: Removing duplicate audio can disrupt transition timing

title: Waveforms missing or very slow
causes: Audio conforming/cache activity, invalid media or cache path
tests: Check playback first, then review cache state and a known-good PCM WAV; avoid deleting camera files
confirm: Waveform returns and decoded audio matches source
prevention: Keep cache volume writable with sufficient free space
side_effects: Cache refresh may take time and consume disk space

title: Overlays disappear in vertical crop
causes: Auto Reframe/crop composition excludes titles or graphics, or safe margins are wrong
tests: Duplicate original sequence; compare text layer position and output crop; check phone interface safe areas
confirm: Every required label remains legible in exported vertical master
prevention: Use aspect-ratio-specific title layouts
side_effects: Resizing the sequence may change effect and transform framing

title: Wrong language in transcription
causes: Incorrect language selection, noisy recording, accents or unavailable service
tests: Check transcript language settings, inspect source audio, compare proper nouns against recording
confirm: Corrected transcript matches speech and caption timestamps
prevention: Use a manual transcript quality-control pass for names and numbers
side_effects: Corrections can change text-based edit selections

title: Multicam cut selects wrong microphone
causes: Audio follows video when fixed source audio was intended, or mixed source routing
tests: Inspect multicam audio-follow-video policy; test angle changes while monitoring meters
confirm: Camera angle changes do not unintentionally replace the selected primary mic
prevention: Establish one audio strategy before editing
side_effects: Audio-follow-video can be appropriate for live music, so preserve alternate version

title: Title animation flickers or jitters
causes: Subpixel motion, field handling, rasterization, overly small type or export scaling
tests: Inspect at full-resolution Program Monitor and exported file; compare movement without effects
confirm: Motion remains readable and stable at target frame rate
prevention: Use sensible type size and avoid excessive thin-line motion
side_effects: Subpixel adjustments can change graphic alignment

title: Film looks noisy after correction
causes: High ISO source, elevated shadows, aggressive sharpening or denoise failure
tests: Compare before/after with scopes and 100% view; disable one correction at a time
confirm: Texture and detail are acceptable without artificial smearing
prevention: Expose within camera limits and preserve clean masters
side_effects: Heavy denoise may remove real fine details

title: Export file plays silently
causes: Audio export disabled, missing channel mapping, muted audio or incompatible player
tests: Verify Export Audio setting; import rendered file back into Premiere; check audio streams using a separate player
confirm: Reimport shows expected audio track and normal spoken playback
prevention: Use short preflight exports before long renders
side_effects: Changing channel type can affect deliverable specifications

title: Burn-in captions unexpectedly double
causes: Both captions are baked into pixels and a player sidecar/embedded caption layer is enabled
tests: Inspect output in a caption-disabled player; check deliverable caption mode and sidecar naming
confirm: Exactly one intended caption presentation remains
prevention: Specify burn-in, embedded or sidecar per platform in delivery checklist
side_effects: Removing sidecar can reduce accessibility options

title: Imported footage has no picture but audio works
causes: Unsupported codec/profile, decode failure or VFR/device issue
tests: Check container and codec separately; compare supported intermediate on a copy and system decode support
confirm: Video decodes consistently in Source Monitor and after export
prevention: Test new camera codec on the target workstation before a large shoot
side_effects: Transcoding can alter metadata/timebase; keep camera-original

title: Project becomes unusually large or slow to open
causes: Many linked assets, excessive sequences, high-resolution thumbnails or project corruption
tests: Duplicate project; remove one high-cost bin on a test copy; compare load times
confirm: Project opens repeatably without losing necessary links
prevention: Organize Productions/sequence versions and periodic project backups
side_effects: Consolidation or cleanup can break collaboration if done on shared original

title: Media Encoder queue does not match Premiere export
causes: Different sequence state, preset, codec availability or stale queue items
tests: Write down preset and output path; re-queue a short test section; compare exported metadata
confirm: Queued render matches agreed output settings and picture/audio state
prevention: Version-lock Media Encoder and document export preset per deliverable
side_effects: Changing queue item may overwrite an earlier approved file

title: Dark border after stabilization
causes: Stabilized edge translation exposes empty pixels and crop settings are insufficient
tests: Toggle stabilization; inspect corners in motion; adjust crop/scale on a duplicate
confirm: No unwanted edge gaps throughout shot
prevention: Shoot extra framing margin for handheld shots
side_effects: Scaling reduces effective picture detail
